other_failure_modes.name: Encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical frequency encoding and TF-IDF vectorization are fit on the entire dataset (train and test combined) before splitting. This leaks the distribution and vocabulary of the test set into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Target transformation evaluation mismatch
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies a log transformation to the target variable before training, but computes the validation metric (RMSE) directly on these log-transformed targets and predictions. This results in computing RMSLE while labelling it as RMSE, yielding a misleadingly low validation score that does not correspond to the true objective scale.

summary: The agent implements a robust CatBoost regression pipeline with thoughtful feature engineering, including TF-IDF and SVD for text. However, it introduces severe data leakage by fitting SVD, TF-IDF, and frequency encoders on the combined train and test sets prior to splitting. Furthermore, it ignores the temporal nature of contract awards by using random cross-validation, and computes its validation metric on a log-transformed target, reporting an incorrect metric scale.
